{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wool-blend blazer in navy blue (#000080), tailored fit with structured shoulders and notch lapels, mid-thigh length.  
Slim-fit wool-blend trousers in charcoal grey (#36454F), straight-leg cut with a clean drape from hip to ankle.  
Cotton-poplin blouse in cream white (#FFFFFF), relaxed fit with a button-down front and rounded neckline, hitting just below the waist.  
Leather ankle boots in black (#000000), almond toe with a low block heel, reaching mid-calf for comfort during the day.  

This outfit works perfectly for an autumn office day because the navy blazer and charcoal trousers provide a polished, professional silhouette suitable for business norms without feeling restrictive. The cream blouse adds a soft contrast that keeps the look fresh and approachable while maintaining neatness. The ankle boots offer both style and practical comfort for walking around the office environment during cooler weather."}
